chemistry-killer-06.title: Marongero eshanduko yeruvara dze
chemistry-killer-06.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-06.material:
Marongero eshanduko yeruvara dze indicators ndeaya:
Methyl orange: tsvuku pa pH < 3.1, orenji pa 3.1 kusvika 4.4, yero pa pH > 4.4
BTB: yero pa pH < 6.0, girinhi pa 6.0 kusvika 7.6, bhuruu pa pH > 7.6
Phenolphthalein: isina ruvara pa pH < 8.3, pingi pa 8.3 kusvika 10.0, tsvuku pa pH > 10.0
Ma aqueous solution matatu emazuva ose akaedzwa nema indicators ose matatu.
(A) Stomach-acid model solution: methyl orange tsvuku, BTB yero, phenolphthalein isina ruvara
(B) Solution mushure mekuwedzerwa kwe antacid uye yapindura zvizere: methyl orange yero, BTB yero, phenolphthalein isina ruvara
(C) Dilute sodium hydrogencarbonate solution: methyl orange yero, BTB bhuruu, phenolphthalein isina ruvara
Kana pH range inogutsa mhedzisiro dzema indicators ose matatu ikaderedzwa kusvika pakadiki zvakanyanya, ndeipi sarudzo inopa nemazvo ma pH range e (A), (B), (C) nenzira iyoyo?
chemistry-killer-06.s.s1.prompt:

BTB: yero pa pH < 6.0, girinhi pa 6.0 kusvika 7.6, bhuruu pa pH > 7.6
Phenolphthalein: isina ruvara pa pH < 8.3, pingi pa 8.3 kusvika 10.0, tsvuku pa pH > 10.0
Ma aqueous solution matatu emazuva ose akaedzwa nema indicators ose matatu.

(B) Solution mushure mekuwedzerwa kwe antacid uye yapindura zvizere: methyl orange yero, BTB yero, phenolphthalein isina ruvara
(C) Dilute sodium hydrogencarbonate solution: methyl orange yero, BTB bhuruu, phenolphthalein isina ruvara
Kana pH range inogutsa mhedzisiro dzema indicators ose matatu ikaderedzwa kusvika pakadiki zvakanyanya, ndeipi sarudzo inopa nemazvo ma pH range e (A), (B), (C) nenzira iyoyo?
chemistry-killer-06.s.s1.explain:
(A): methyl orange tsvuku pH < 3.1, BTB yero pH < 6.0, phenolphthalein isina ruvara pH < 8.3. Range yakafanana: pH < 3.1.
(B): methyl orange yero pH > 4.4, BTB yero pH < 6.0, phenolphthalein isina ruvara pH < 8.3. Range yakafanana: 4.4 < pH < 6.0.
(C): methyl orange yero pH > 4.4, BTB bhuruu pH > 7.6, phenolphthalein isina ruvara pH < 8.3. Range yakafanana: 7.6 < pH < 8.3.
Pindura: (A) pH < 3.1, (B) 4.4 < pH < 6.0, (C) 7.6 < pH < 8.3 (b). (Sarudzo dzisiri dzakarurama: kuverenga (A) se 3.1 kusvika 4.4 kunosanganisa tsvuku neorenji; kuverenga (B) se 6.0 kusvika 7.6 kunosanganisa BTB yero negirinhi; yekupedzisira inoshandisa BTB range chete uye haisi iyo yakadiki zvakanyanya.)
